description: Activate when: user says 'make our products buyable by AI shopping agents', 'is our product data agent-ready?', 'agentic commerce', 'the agent failed to place the order', asks 'why doesn't ChatGPT / a shopping agent recommend or buy our products?', is preparing a product feed for an AI assistant or an agent checkout protocol, or wants a catalog that AI agents can read, compare and purchase from. Do NOT activate when: the goal is only how often the brand is mentioned inside AI answers (use geo-generative-engine-optimization); there is no online purchase channel; the business is offline-only or quote-based B2B; the category may not legally be sold through automated channels. More: deciqai.com/c/agent-ready-product-data

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent apply safe operational sequencing and rollback awareness?
Did the agent verify final system state with concrete evidence?
